inscription.alchyforbidden.echo_sight.ef: Hostile mobs near you glow, even through walls.
inscription.alchyforbidden.clear_mind.ef: Blindness, darkness and nausea slide off you.
Your breath lasts far longer under water.
inscription.alchyforbidden.essence_reser: Your body holds Wrath, Sorrow and Corruption like a vessel, and pours it into an altar you stand by.
inscription.alchyforbidden.deep_heart.ef: Three more hearts and some knockback resistance.
inscription.alchyforbidden.wrathful_arms: The lower your health, the harder you hit.
inscription.alchyforbidden.chained_wings: Jump in the air to glide, as with an elytra that never breaks.
inscription.alchyforbidden.echo_wings.ef: You can fly, as in creative.
You run faster and step up a whole block.
inscription.alchyforbidden.high_leap.eff: You jump higher and fall further unhurt.
inscription.alchyforbidden.silent_step.e: Half the fall damage; your steps make no vibration.
You walk on water (sneak to sink).
inscription.alchyforbidden.lava_walker.e: You walk on lava (sneak to sink).
inscription.alchyforbidden.sky_walker.ef: The air holds you where you stand (sneak to go down).
inscription.alchyforbidden.fire_skin.eff: Fire and lava do not burn you.
inscription.alchyforbidden.thorn_skin.ef: A quarter of every blow goes back to who struck you.
inscription.alchyforbidden.part.head: Head

inscription.alchyforbidden.bier_holds: The bier holds %s Wrath, %s Sorrow, %s Corruption
inscription.alchyforbidden.power: Corruption is power: every carving beyond the first makes all of them %s%% stronger
inscription.alchyforbidden.stronger: The corruption deepens: your carvings now work at %s%%.
inscription.alchyforbidden.scales: Stronger with every carving you carry
inscribing_bier.alchyforbidden.part_full: That part holds %s carvings at this tier%s
inscribing_bier.alchyforbidden.grow_more: : grow the bier for more room
inscription.alchyforbidden.pale_mind.eff: Poison, Wither and Hunger slide off you.
inscription.alchyforbidden.iron_gut.effe: Your stomach makes do: a point of food comes back every 30 seconds, sooner on a stronger body.
inscription.alchyforbidden.second_breath: Once every 5 minutes (sooner on a stronger body), a killing blow leaves you standing, with regeneration and absorption.
inscription.alchyforbidden.heavy_hand.ef: Your blows hit harder and throw the struck further back.
inscription.alchyforbidden.soul_siphon.e: Each blow you strike heals you for a share of it.
Whoever strikes you is slowed and weakened.
inscription.alchyforbidden.second_leap.e: Jump again in mid-air (twice on a strong body).
Walk into a wall to climb it; sneak to hold on.
inscription.alchyforbidden.bark_skin.eff: Your skin hardens like bark: more armour and toughness.
inscription.alchyforbidden.tough_metabol: No harmful effect can take hold of you.
essence_infuser.alchyforbidden.bound: The infuser is bound to you: it pours its essence into your reserve while it is loaded.
essence_infuser.alchyforbidden.unbound: The infuser lets go of you.
essence_infuser.alchyforbidden.no_reserv: Only a body carved with an Essence Reserve can be bound to it.
essence_infuser.alchyforbidden.too_low: It binds to a body only at its third tier.

gui.alchyforbidden.circle_locked: The circle binds it at tier %s

spell.alchyforbidden.no_essence: Not enough essence in your reserve or vessels.
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_bolt.effect: A bolt of the rift at what you look at, up to 24 blocks.
spell.alchyforbidden.mist_step.effect: You step through the mist to where you look, up to 10 blocks.
spell.alchyforbidden.soul_shield.effect: Souls wrap you: absorption and resistance for a while.
spell.alchyforbidden.sculk_fangs.effect: A line of fangs bursts from the ground before you.
spell.alchyforbidden.wail.effect: A wail of grief: mobs round you are slowed and weakened.
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_chains.effect: Chains of the rift hold the creature you look at in place.
spell.alchyforbidden.black_hole.effect: A rift opens where you look, pulling in and crushing what is near for 4 seconds.
spell.alchyforbidden.sonic_boom.effect: The warden's scream: a blast through everything in a line of 15 blocks.
spell.alchyforbidden.echo_pulse.effect: A pulse of the sculk's sense: every creature within 24 blocks glows, even through walls.
spell.alchyforbidden.soul_drain.effect: Tears at the soul of the creature you look at: it is hurt and you are healed by part of it.
spell.alchyforbidden.wrath_nova.effect: You burst into a ring of fire: everything round you burns and is thrown back.
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_gate.effect: A rift opens before you and another where you look, up to 40 blocks: you step through.
spell.alchyforbidden.blood_rite.effect: Pay 6 health for Strength II, Speed II and Haste II for a while.
spell.alchyforbidden.blood_rite.weak: Too weak to pay in blood.
spell.alchyforbidden.great_leap.effect: A great leap the way you look. Your landing does not hurt.
spell.alchyforbidden.drifting_soul.effec: You drift down like a soul: slow falling for 30 seconds.
spell.alchyforbidden.shadow_veil.effect: Invisible for 30 seconds, and the creatures hunting you lose you.
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_pocket.effect: A small rift to your own pocket of the void: your ender chest, anywhere.
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_anchor.effect: Cast while sneaking to drop an anchor where you stand (free). Cast to be taken back to it through a rift (same world).
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_anchor.none: No anchor in this world: cast it while sneaking first.

item.alchyforbidden.gem.hint: Click it onto a spell ring to set it in a free socket, or use the bench in a Binding Circle (Rings tab). Several of a kind add up.

gui.alchyforbidden.rings_locked: Opens when you use a Binding Circle of tier %s
gui.alchyforbidden.rings_bench: Bench: set gems in a ring
gui.alchyforbidden.gem_no_ring: Put a ring on the bench to see its sockets.
gui.alchyforbidden.gem_socket: A gem socket: put a gem in, or take it out.
gui.alchyforbidden.gem_locked: Ring I has 1 socket, ring II 2, ring III 4.
gui.alchyforbidden.rings_hint: Wear and order rings at a Binding Circle.
binding_circle.alchyforbidden.known: Your soul already holds that spell.
gui.alchyforbidden.spells_known: Bound spells (click one, then a slot)
Drops and experience within 6 blocks drift to you.
Your first blow marks a creature (it glows). Marked prey takes 25% more from you for 8 seconds.
inscription.alchyforbidden.carrion_feast: Every kill feeds you: food and saturation back, with a disgusting burp.
inscription.alchyforbidden.vampiric_hear: Every kill heals you 2 hearts and gives a moment of regeneration.
inscription.alchyforbidden.rift_fist.eff: Every fourth melee blow bursts: a sonic shockwave throws everything round the target back.
inscription.alchyforbidden.vein_rip.effe: Breaking an ore tears out the whole vein (up to 12 blocks, more on a stronger body). Sneak to mine one.
inscription.alchyforbidden.executioner.e: A melee blow that leaves a creature under 15% health kills it outright, messily. Not bosses.
Every 3 seconds the nearest monster bleeds into you: it loses health, you gain it.
inscription.alchyforbidden.grasping_tend: Every 2 seconds tendrils of sculk drag the nearest monster within 8 blocks to you and slow it.
inscription.alchyforbidden.moon_step.eff: Sneak in the air to drift down like a feather.
Falling more than 4 blocks makes a crater: everything round your landing is crushed and thrown, and you take much less.
inscription.alchyforbidden.ember_trail.e: Sprinting leaves fire in your wake: whatever you pass burns.
inscription.alchyforbidden.toxic_ooze.ef: Your skin drips. Whoever strikes you is poisoned and sickened.
inscription.alchyforbidden.mirror_skin.e: A chance (20%, more on a stronger body) to throw a projectile back at whoever shot it.
spell.alchyforbidden.bone_spear.effect: A spear of bone flung at what you look at, up to 20 blocks, knocking it back.
spell.alchyforbidden.bile_spray.effect: You retch a cone of sculk bile: everything in front of you is poisoned, slowed and hurt.
spell.alchyforbidden.wisp_light.effect: Sets a wisp of soul light where you look. It fades after a minute.
spell.alchyforbidden.sculk_snare.effect: Sculk spreads where you look for 20 seconds: any creature that walks in is held fast.
spell.alchyforbidden.gore_burst.effect: The creature you look at bursts from within. If it dies, it explodes on everything round it.
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_meteor.effect: A rift tears open high over where you look and a burning stone crashes down. No block damage.
spell.alchyforbidden.stasis_field.effect: Time stops round you: every creature within 10 blocks is frozen where it stands.
spell.alchyforbidden.verdant_pulse.effec: Every plant round you grows as if bone-mealed twice.
spell.alchyforbidden.rift_bore.effect: Bores a 3 by 3 tunnel 6 blocks ahead of you. Its blocks drop; containers and hard blocks are left.
spell.alchyforbidden.sculk_plague.effect: Sculk takes root in every creature within 10 blocks and rots them. When one dies, the plague jumps on.
spell.alchyforbidden.soul_storm.effect: For 6 seconds souls fall on the monsters round you, and each strike heals you a little.
spell.alchyforbidden.abyssal_form.effect: Become the rift's avatar for 15 seconds: Strength III, Resistance II, Speed II, Regeneration II, Jump Boost II.
spell.alchyforbidden.shadow_strike.effec: Shadows of you tear out and fall on up to 3 monsters within 12 blocks (more on a stronger body), slashing and blinding them.
inscribing_bier.alchyforbidden.full_slot: Your body holds %s carvings: open more in the Slots tab, or burn one away.
inscribing_bier.alchyforbidden.slots_max: Your body is opened as far as it goes.
inscribing_bier.alchyforbidden.slots_tie: The bier must stand at tier %s for this.
inscribing_bier.alchyforbidden.slots_ope: Your body opens: it can carry %s carvings now.

item.alchyforbidden.rift_lure.boss: A great one: it fights with all it has

familiar.alchyforbidden.full_level: It has nothing left to learn.
trait.alchyforbidden.sculk_crawler.cling: Its bite also leaves its prey weakened.
trait.alchyforbidden.sculk_crawler.sculk: What it kills bursts into sculk, hurting the monsters round it.
trait.alchyforbidden.sculk_crawler.pounc: A bite from a leap strikes half as hard again.
trait.alchyforbidden.sculk_crawler.echo_: One bite in six is struck again by its echo a moment later.

move.alchyforbidden.sculk_crawler.sculk_: Rears and spits sculk up to 14 blocks: slows and blinds what it hits.
move.alchyforbidden.sculk_crawler.burrow: Digs into the ground, goes under unseen and bursts up beneath its prey, throwing it up.
move.alchyforbidden.sculk_crawler.shriek: Rears and shrieks: every foe within 7 blocks is hurt, thrown back and darkened.
gui.alchyforbidden.bestiary_grades: Called creatures can come altered: Rifted, Deep-Rifted or Void-Rifted, each stronger and bigger.
gui.alchyforbidden.bestiary_move_at: Move, learned at level %s: every %ss, %s to %s blocks
gui.alchyforbidden.bestiary_hover: Hover a sign to read it.

rift_maw.alchyforbidden.corrupt_max: It is Void-Rifted: the rift has nothing deeper to give.

rift_maw.alchyforbidden.corrupt_failed: %s rejected the rift. Its ring cracked for %s minutes.
rift_maw.alchyforbidden.corrupted: %s sank deeper into the rift and gained %s.
affix.alchyforbidden.vampiric.desc: Heals a quarter of the damage of each blow it lands.
affix.alchyforbidden.blinking.desc: Struck, it may slip through a small rift to beside its attacker.
affix.alchyforbidden.thorned.desc: Whoever strikes it in melee takes a quarter of the blow back.
affix.alchyforbidden.frenzied.desc: Under half health it moves and hits a quarter faster and harder.
affix.alchyforbidden.splitting.desc: Once a fight, badly hurt, an echo of it tears out of the rift and fights for ten seconds.
affix.alchyforbidden.hungering.desc: Each kill while it is out makes it hit 10% harder, up to five.
affix.alchyforbidden.warded.desc: A ward takes the first heavy blow; it comes back after 30 seconds.
affix.alchyforbidden.voidtouched.desc: A part of each blow goes through any armour.
affix.alchyforbidden.grave_bound.desc: Once each time it is called, it refuses to die and gets back up.
affix.alchyforbidden.burning.desc: Its blows set its prey on fire.
gui.alchyforbidden.maw_catalyst_slot: Rift Residue as a catalyst: each one moves %s%% toward the altered grades (up to %s). Taken by the ritual.
gui.alchyforbidden.maw_conditions: The rift gives more of itself:
gui.alchyforbidden.maw_filter_tip: Choose which affixes the maw's rituals (the call and the corrupting) may roll. The fewer kept, the dearer: Void Prisms and Rift Residue.
gui.alchyforbidden.maw_filter_cost_tip: Each ritual with this filter takes %s Void Prisms (the prism slot first, then your inventory) and %s Rift Residue (your inventory), on top of its own cost. A creature can come with fewer affixes if fewer are allowed.
gui.alchyforbidden.hand_release_tip: Let it go back into the rift for good: you keep the blank ring and get %s Rift Residue. Click twice.
rift_maw.alchyforbidden.filter_none: Your filter allows no affix it does not already have.
rift_maw.alchyforbidden.released: %s went back into the rift. You got %s Rift Residue.
gui.alchyforbidden.maw_prism_slot: Void Prisms for your affix filter: taken from here first, then from your inventory.
trait.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.soul_siph: Its bolts heal it a third of the damage they do.
trait.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.veil.desc: One blow in five passes through it as through mist.
trait.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.piercing_: Its bolts go through the first foe to strike the next.
trait.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.twin_flam: It throws two bolts at once.
move.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.rift_barra: Draws its soul back and throws a fan of three bolts.
move.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.blink_away: A foe too close: it slips through a rift six to eight blocks away.
move.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.soul_snare: Rift chains hold its prey in place and weaken it for over two seconds.
move.alchyforbidden.veil_wisp.spectral_r: Small rifts open over its prey and bolts rain down round it.
trait.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.keen_fa: One bite in five strikes twice.
trait.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.pack_bo: Its owner and their familiars near it run faster.
trait.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.shatter: Struck, it sheds shards into what stands round it.
trait.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.prismat: Arrows and bolts do it half their damage.
move.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.crystal_: Crouches, then dashes straight through its prey and whatever is in the way.
move.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.shard_vo: Shakes its spines loose: a ring of shards flies out, one more at its prey.
move.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.howl.des: Foes round it are weakened and slowed; its owner and familiars are strengthened.
move.alchyforbidden.shard_hound.crystall: Locks its prey in growing amethyst, then the crystal bursts.
trait.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.crus: Its blows slow and throw its prey far.
trait.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.taun: Monsters coming for its owner turn on it instead.
trait.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.iron: Under 30% health it takes 40% less damage.
trait.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.chai: Each blow drags its prey back in and holds it a moment.
move.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.groun: Brings both fists down: a shockwave throws up everything within 4 blocks.
move.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.chain: Throws a chain up to 12 blocks and drags its prey to it.
move.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.earth: Leaps onto its prey and breaks the ground: everything within 5 blocks is hurt and slowed.
move.alchyforbidden.shackled_brute.wreck: Whirls its chains round it for three seconds, striking and pulling in all within 4 blocks.
trait.alchyforbidden.hollow_stalker.back: Strikes half as hard again from behind.
trait.alchyforbidden.hollow_stalker.lurk: In the dark it hits a quarter harder and runs faster.
trait.alchyforbidden.hollow_stalker.blee: Its claws leave wounds that wither.
trait.alchyforbidden.hollow_stalker.deat: Prey under 30% health takes double damage from it.
move.alchyforbidden.hollow_stalker.shado: Steps through a rift behind its prey and strikes.
Fades from sight; its next blow strikes twice as hard.
move.alchyforbidden.hollow_stalker.rendi: Four slashes in a single breath.
move.alchyforbidden.hollow_stalker.hollo: Lifts its prey into the air, holds it, then slams it into the ground.
trait.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.abys: Blows struck up close do a quarter less.
trait.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.clea: Its swings also strike everything in front of it.
trait.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.unyi: Nothing slows it or pushes it.
trait.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.echo: Under half health, once, its echo rises and fights beside it for 15 seconds.
move.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.rift_: A wave of rift flies from its blade, cutting through everything in front of it for 8 blocks.
move.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.void_: Charges, throwing up into the air whatever it meets.
move.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.abyss: Marks the ground under its prey; a column of rift falls on it a moment later.
move.alchyforbidden.abyssal_knight.rift_: Plants its blade: everything within 10 blocks is pulled in, then the rift bursts.
trait.alchyforbidden.the_choir.harmony.d: It, its owner and their familiars round it mend a heart every two seconds.
trait.alchyforbidden.the_choir.discord.d: What its voices strike is weakened and reels.
trait.alchyforbidden.the_choir.choir_of_: Every five seconds each head sings a small bolt at its prey.
trait.alchyforbidden.the_choir.requiem.d: Near death, once, one great shriek strikes everything round it and heals it.
move.alchyforbidden.the_choir.sonic_boom: Every head opens together: a beam of sound through its prey, past any armour.
move.alchyforbidden.the_choir.wail_of_so: A cone of grief: everything in it is hurt, darkened and slowed.
move.alchyforbidden.the_choir.canticle.d: Each head in turn throws a piercing bolt.
A long rising note, then a shockwave that throws everything within 8 blocks away.
trait.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.feat: Each of its blows also throws two blades of light.
trait.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.grac: One blow in four passes through it.
trait.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.seve: Its broken halo sets alight whatever stands within 3 blocks.
trait.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.asce: Badly hurt, once a call, it rises and mends a quarter of its health.
move.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.heave: A column of light marks where it will fall, then it falls there: everything within 3 blocks is struck.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.title: Void Trial
void_trial.alchyforbidden.unworthy: You were struck down in the void and cast out of the rift. The lure and the essence are lost.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.fled: You left the void arena. The trial is lost.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.time: The rift grew tired of waiting and cast you out. The trial is lost.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.vanished: The great one slipped back into the rift. The trial is lost.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.taken: You stood on the maw: the rift takes you with %s.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.joined: You came into the void arena: you fight beside %s.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.lead_gone: The challenger left the void. The trial is lost.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.party_lost: The challenger was cast out of the rift. The trial is lost.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.won_beside_lin: %s is bound to %s. The rift leaves you some residue.
Its candle bolts set what they strike alight.
The ghosts it frees fight longer, and in its arena every one of them mends it while it lives.
What its bolts strike is slowed.
Blows struck on it by hand hurt a quarter less.
move.alchyforbidden.weeping_chandelier.w: Burning wax rains round its prey, leaving puddles that burn and slow.
trait.alchyforbidden.void_golem.obsidian: While its shell holds it takes a third less (a familiar: a fifth less).
trait.alchyforbidden.void_golem.crushing: Its blows slow and tire what they strike.
trait.alchyforbidden.void_golem.void_hea: Unhurt for five seconds, its core mends it two hearts a second.
trait.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.hollow_: Arrows and bolts pass half through it.
trait.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.sculk_m: Its bites mend it a quarter of what they take.
trait.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.bone_ar: Every ten seconds a plate of bone takes the next blow.
trait.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.death_r: Dying, it bursts into a storm of bone shards.
move.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.bone_rai: Spikes of bone rain round its prey.
move.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.sonic_br: A breath of sound strafes across its prey, blinding and withering what it touches.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.nova_warning: The candles are lighting: break them before they all burn!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.shield_warning: Stones circle it: only critical blows break them.
move.alchyforbidden.weeping_chandelier.s: Six soul flames leave its candles and hunt its prey.
move.alchyforbidden.weeping_chandelier.c: It hauls itself up its chain, then lets go and crashes onto the floor: a ring rolls out from the impact. Jump it.
move.alchyforbidden.weeping_chandelier.f: Three drowned guests come out of it to fight. In its arena they heal it until they are killed.
trait.alchyforbidden.void_golem.taunt.de: Nothing slows it, and monsters going for its owner turn on it instead.
move.alchyforbidden.void_golem.slam.desc: Both fists into the floor: shockwave lines run out and throw up what they cross.
move.alchyforbidden.void_golem.slab_thro: It tears a slab out of the floor and throws it. In its arena the slab lands standing and stays as cover.
move.alchyforbidden.void_golem.stone_gua: Arms crossed before it: nothing from the front gets through for a few seconds.
move.alchyforbidden.void_golem.void_pull: Everything within 14 blocks is pulled in, then blasted away.
move.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.wyrm_div: Its shadow marks the floor, then it falls on that spot.
move.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon.sonic_ro: A roar in a cone before it: everything in it is hurt, slowed and thrown back.
move.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.blade: Seven blades of light fly out and come back like boomerangs.
move.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.feath: Burning feathers are thrown all round it.
move.alchyforbidden.severed_seraph.blink: Three times it slips through a small rift to behind its prey and cuts.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.guests_warning: Its guests are healing it: kill them!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.guard_warning: It guards its front: strike from behind.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.dragon_down: It crashed into the floor: strike now!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.breath_warning: It draws a breath for the whole arena: hide behind the bone walls!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.great_one: A great one of the rift
epithet.alchyforbidden.bone_dragon: The Wyrm That Would Not Rest
void_trial.alchyforbidden.golem_guard: It guards its front: strike it from behind three times to break the guard.
void_trial.alchyforbidden.golem_stuck: Its fists are stuck in the floor: strike now!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.golem_staggere: Its guard is broken: strike now!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.golem_quake: The floor quakes: jump the shockwaves!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.golem_collapse: The core collapses: get away from it!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.dragon_rest: It lands to catch its breath: strike now!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.dragon_wall: It slammed into the wall: strike now!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.strafe_warning: It dives for a strafing run: get off its shadow!
void_trial.alchyforbidden.charge_warning: It lowers its head to charge: sidestep it, lead it into a wall!
gui.alchyforbidden.kindled: Kindled: it works %s%% harder for %s s.
gui.alchyforbidden.kindle_full: It burns already (%s s left): it can hold no more.
item.alchyforbidden.wrath_ember.kindles: Feed it to a Killing Pit: +50%% Wrath for 60 s
item.alchyforbidden.sorrow_tear.kindles: Feed it to a Lament Well: +50%% Sorrow for 60 s
item.alchyforbidden.corruption_spore.kin: Feed it to an Echo Resonator: +50%% Corruption for 60 s
item.alchyforbidden.mourning_pearl.kindl: Feed it to a Weeping Fountain: weeps twice as fast for 120 s
info.alchyforbidden.guide.landing: The grimoire of a mage left for dead in a buried city, who learned to bind what hunts there.$(br2)Start with $(l:fall/foreword)Read This First$(). Later chapters open as you go deeper.
jei.alchyforbidden.spell_where: Binding Circle tier %s, in a ring of its tier
jei.alchyforbidden.creature_where: Rift Maw tier %s, a blank ring of its tier
jei.alchyforbidden.creature_arena: Fought in an arena of %s blocks
jei.alchyforbidden.creature_void: Fought in the void, %s blocks round
jei.alchyforbidden.creature_bind: Kill it to bind it in the ring
jei.alchyforbidden.creature_more: Its traits and moves: the Rift Bestiary
jei.alchyforbidden.infuser_from: From its own store, filled by links, or an awake altar within %s blocks
jei.alchyforbidden.infuser_bond: Bound to a player: +%s of each essence a second into their carved reserve
